# Grand Transition repository skills

Read [`AGENTS.md`](../../AGENTS.md) and the applicable approved specification
before using a skill. Use commands from the current repository configuration.
Do not invent missing scripts.

| Skill | Use for |
| --- | --- |
| [`add-feature`](add-feature/SKILL.md) | Define, implement, or repair approved product behavior. |
| [`create-skill`](create-skill/SKILL.md) | Create, import, adapt, or review repository skills. |
| [`dead-code-audit`](dead-code-audit/SKILL.md) | Prove reachability before reporting or removing dead items. |
| [`design-grand-transition-ui`](design-grand-transition-ui/SKILL.md) | Design, audit, implement, or verify the Lit interface. |
| [`deslop`](deslop/SKILL.md) | Remove only evidence-backed unsupported content. |
| [`diagnose`](diagnose/SKILL.md) | Reproduce and isolate difficult failures. |
| [`full-code-review`](full-code-review/SKILL.md) | Review a diff, branch, milestone, or complete checkout. |
| [`grill-me`](grill-me/SKILL.md) | Resolve one product, architecture, or design decision at a time. |
| [`improve-codebase-architecture`](improve-codebase-architecture/SKILL.md) | Review or improve ownership and module boundaries. |
| [`refactor`](refactor/SKILL.md) | Improve structure without changing behavior. |
| [`run-quality-gate`](run-quality-gate/SKILL.md) | Run or repair configured repository checks. |
| [`update-game-content`](update-game-content/SKILL.md) | Change phrases, characters, scenes, localization, or editorial data. |
| [`verify-game`](verify-game/SKILL.md) | Collect production-build browser and game evidence. |

Audits, reviews, and diagnosis remain read-only unless the user requests a
repair. Preserve unrelated work, generated files, private masters, binaries,
fixtures, and lockfiles.
